# vendor/

## AxiDraw_API.zip

The Evil Mad Scientist (EMS) AxiDraw API, committed here because it is not on PyPI.

- Source URL: https://cdn.evilmadscientist.com/dl/ad/public/AxiDraw_API.zip
  This is an unversioned "latest" link, so a re-download may give a different version.
- Version: AxiDraw API 3.9.6
- Size: 382561 bytes
- SHA-256: C29EF0792DC8A2006A3A4ABCB306E8D7FA5B93F8CE83C0C781EED226D7EECA24

Licensing: `pyaxidraw` and `axidrawinternal` are GPL-2.0-or-later. `plotink` and the CLI/examples
are MIT. The committed zip is the corresponding source for the bundled EMS engine.

Install it with `constraints.txt`, as shown in the top-level README:

    .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -c constraints.txt vendor\AxiDraw_API.zip
